fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: Pulses arcana out from you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Chew the Cud
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of arcana that uses up one of your afflictions on the target to deal 8 damage, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Herd Warmth
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds and fights with 1 more power while it holds. Using it restores 10 health to whoever is worst off.

fusions.name: Contented Grazing
fusions.desc: When your health is full, you regain 2 mana a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
